Our Marketing Specialists are embedded directly with growth-stage businesses and entrepreneurial leaders who need creatively sharp, independently driven operators. It's a dedicated role designed for meaningful impact, stability, and professional growth. About the Role A premier South Central luxury lighting, hardware, and furniture agency - serving architects, designers, contractors, distributors, and hospitality professionals - is seeking a systems-fluent, detail-obsessed Marketing Operations to own CRM and automation infrastructure, email marketing execution, and process documentation, with a secondary layer of creative production support. Monitor automation performance (open rates, pipeline movement, funnel drop-off) and proactively flag and fix breakdowns. Maintain organized project tracking via Monday.com, working to weekly agendas and delivering structured updates without requiring follow-up. Content & Creative Support (secondary focus) Support LinkedIn presence with scheduling and light engagement to grow reach among architects, designers, contractors, and hospitality professionals. Leverage AI tools to speed up content and copy production where needed.
